messages:
incident-bot: PAGING: Router p99 tail spike detected (ingress-lb) across eu-west-2. Alert: p99=1420ms (SLO 800ms). Affected routes: /v1/generate streaming sessions show stalls. Monitored increase started 00:03 UTC. Pager: @Mel (oncall)
Mel (oncall): on it. joining #warroom. any ETA on scope? :eyes:
Alice: looking at routing telemetry now. early hypothesis: weight drift + hotpartition on router group euw2-shard-7. seeing sudden 10x queue depth on that shard.
Ben: I can flip fallback policy to force eager-fallback across euw2 pool if needed. that should reduce tail but increase cost. want me to proceed?
Carla: FYI customer-impact: two larger customers showing increased stream stalls and token timeouts (customer-a-prod, customer-c-analytics). support already triaging.
Mel (oncall): do it Ben. go ahead with eager-fallback + reduce routing weight to shard-7 by 70%. Post commands you run.
Ben: running command:
```
routerctl set-weight --region eu-west-2 --shard euw2-shard-7 --weight 0.3
routerctl set-fallback-policy --region eu-west-2 --policy eager
```
Applying...
infra-bot: action accepted: weight update queued (op id 0x9f4a). fallback policy change started (op id 0x9f4b).
Alice: telemetry: queue depth on shard-7 falling within 20s of policy change. p99 trending down from 1420 -> 620ms. p95 also down from 360->240ms.
Carla: customer-c reports partial improvement but some streaming sessions still stall at 4-8s. might be downstream kv-cache miss storm.
SRE-Jordan: checking KV cache hit rates for seq-prefixes from shard-7. 10x miss rate starting at 00:02:49 UTC, possibly due to recent model rollout that invalidated caches.
Mel (oncall): did we roll anything in euw2 recently?
Alice: there was a canary yesterday for model v2.3.1 with small kernel change. infra change?
Ben: model rollout was just metadata; no cache-breaking intended. but routing weight change might have shifted traffic to cold workers losing warm KV.
Carla: open question for customer comms: are sessions timing out or just delayed? Support logs show some token-timeout errors (504) and streaming keepalive disconnects.
Mel (oncall): set mitigation 2: enable prefix-KV warmup for shard-7 and reduce new session routing to 10% while warmup occurs. Ben please run warmup job.
Ben: kicking warmup job:
```
jobs run warmup --shard euw2-shard-7 --prefix-file s3://redwood-ops/euw2/hot-prefixes-2026-03-15.txt --concurrency 50
```
Job started (job id jw-8821). Estimated 3m to hit steady-state.
infra-bot: warmup job jw-8821 accepted, target concurrency 50.
Alice: p99 now 480ms and trending. streaming stalls count dropping. however another signal: routing-controller logs show `policy-eval` exceptions for a minority of requests: `NullRouteDecision` noise. posting snippet:
```
2026-03-15T00:07:12Z router-controller[pid=1428]: WARN policy-eval: NullRouteDecision for request id=... shard=eu-west-2 reason="no-compatible-variant"
```
Might be an upstream policy bug causing brief misroutes to fallback slow-paths.
SRE-Jordan: correlating logs: NullRouteDecision spikes coincide with config reload at 00:06:58 UTC from the rollout manager (not the model). that reload included a new weight-decay heuristic.
Mel (oncall): ok we need to rollback that config patch. Ben, can you revert the routing-controller config to previous stable? Do safe rollback (canary -> global)
Ben: executing rollback: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/routing-controller -n redwood --to-revision=stable-20260314`
infra-bot: rollback initiated (deploy id dpl-447). health checks in progress.
Alice: after rollback, NullRouteDecision errors drop to baseline almost immediately. p99 now stabilizing ~310ms.
Carla: customers reporting degraded to normal for majority of sessions. customer-a still saw 1-2 504s during the window, support making postmortem SL ticket.
Mel (oncall): good. summary so far: root cause composite: 1) policy heuristic change introduced config flakiness (NullRouteDecision) 2) combined with weight drift -> hotpartition on euw2-shard-7 causing KV cold misses -> streaming stalls and p99 spike.
Ben: mitigation list applied: weight reduction for shard-7, eager-fallback, warmup job, rollback of policy heuristic. continuing to monitor.
SRE-Jordan: we've captured full traces for impacted requests and exported to S3: s3://redwood-telemetry/incidents/1764447001/traces.tar.gz
Mel (oncall): oncall handoff in 40m. @SRE-Jordan please be standby for any reversion if p99 creeps back. Alice and Ben, please create follow-up tickets: 
- router: revert heuristic + write unit/regression tests
- routing: add canary safety guard to prevent NullRouteDecision during reload
- serving: make KV warmup automatic on large route shifts
Carla: I'll draft customer incident summary and coordinate with support for impacted SLAs. Recommend SEV-2 -> postmortem.
Mel (oncall): agree. raising SEV-2. I'll capture timeline and close this thread when postmortem PR is ready. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
